I tested all nine pages, but I didn't find a clear FAIL on any of them. Anything I couldn't confirm is marked NEEDS_REVIEW.

I ran scripted checks on every page. They looked at skip links and landmarks, field labels, and the focus outline on every focusable element. I also checked for focus-triggered changes and ran some live interaction tests. I did not walk each page by keyboard from start to finish, so 2.1.1 and 2.4.3 are NEEDS_REVIEW everywhere.

**Findings across the site**
- **Bypass blocks (2.4.1):** No page has a skip link. All except Missions have a `<main>` landmark plus headings, which may count as a bypass mechanism. Missions has no `<main>` or `role=main`, only headings. I left all nine for a person to judge.
- **Focus visible (2.4.7):** Every focusable element I focused showed a focus outline. On the first Tab on Spot the Station the outline was 4px. I did not check whether the outline is visible against its background.
- **Header search field:** It has a visually hidden `<label>` associated by `for`/`id`, so 1.3.1, 2.4.6, 3.3.2 and 4.1.2 pass wherever it is the only visible field.
- **Feedback form:** The "Was this page helpful?" form is zero-size and hidden on every page, so I did not count it.
- **Focus-triggered changes (3.2.1):** Focusing every focusable element did not change the page.
- **Search results and Missions filters (3.2.2):** Ticking a filter checkbox updates results with no submit button and no advance warning. On Missions the URL changed to `?terms=10828`, but focus stayed on the checkbox. That is probably an in-page update rather than a change of context, so I left it for review.
- **NSSC accounts receivable form:**
  - The path as given (no trailing slash) returned a blank page titled "a11y-assist redirect hold". The URL with a trailing slash loaded normally.
  - All 15 visible fields have programmatic labels whose text matches what is shown. That includes the Name and Estimated Date groups, which have legends.
  - Required fields are marked with `*`, and the form says "All fields are required unless otherwise stated".
  - I submitted it empty twice and no validation errors appeared, so I could not test 3.3.1, 3.3.3 or 3.3.4.
- **YouTube embeds and gallery dialog:** Artemis III has one YouTube embed and NACA has five. The KSC gallery has a `role=dialog` element. I did not test these for keyboard traps.

I tested all nine pages, but I didn't find a clear FAIL on any of them. Anything I couldn't confirm is marked NEEDS_REVIEW.

I ran scripted checks on every page. They looked at skip links and landmarks, field labels, and the focus outline on every focusable element. I also checked for focus-triggered changes and ran some live interaction tests. I did not walk each page by keyboard from start to finish, so 2.1.1 and 2.4.3 are NEEDS_REVIEW everywhere.

**Findings across the site**
- **Bypass blocks (2.4.1):** No page has a skip link. All except Missions have a `<main>` landmark plus headings, which may count as a bypass mechanism. Missions has no `<main>` or `role=main`, only headings. I left all nine for a person to judge.
- **Focus visible (2.4.7):** Every focusable element I focused showed a focus outline. On the first Tab on Spot the Station the outline was 4px. I did not check whether the outline is visible against its background.
- **Header search field:** It has a visually hidden `<label>` associated by `for`/`id`, so 1.3.1, 2.4.6, 3.3.2 and 4.1.2 pass wherever it is the only visible field.
- **Feedback form:** The "Was this page helpful?" form is zero-size and hidden on every page, so I did not count it.
- **Focus-triggered changes (3.2.1):** Focusing every focusable element did not change the page.
- **Search results and Missions filters (3.2.2):** Ticking a filter checkbox updates results with no submit button and no advance warning. On Missions the URL changed to `?terms=10828`, but focus stayed on the checkbox. That is probably an in-page update rather than a change of context, so I left it for review.
- **NSSC accounts receivable form:**
  - The path as given (no trailing slash) returned a blank page titled "a11y-assist redirect hold". The URL with a trailing slash loaded normally.
  - All 15 visible fields have programmatic labels whose text matches what is shown. That includes the Name and Estimated Date groups, which have legends.
  - Required fields are marked with `*`, and the form says "All fields are required unless otherwise stated".
  - I submitted it empty twice and no validation errors appeared, so I could not test 3.3.1, 3.3.3 or 3.3.4.
- **YouTube embeds and gallery dialog:** Artemis III has one YouTube embed and NACA has five. The KSC gallery has a `role=dialog` element. I did not test these for keyboard traps.
